name: Lewis
description: Inspector Robert Lewis and Sergeant James Hathaway solve the tough cases that the learned inhabitants of Oxford throw at them.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Inspector Lewis investigates the death of a brilliant young maths student at Oxford University.

videos.title: Whom the Gods Would Destroy
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway are thrown into a delicate case involving one of the Oxford University's most prominent figures.

videos.title: Old School Ties
videos.overview: Lewis comes face to face with his past in a case driven by celebrity, scheming, and dangerous sexual politics.

videos.title: Expiation
videos.overview: When an Oxford housewife is found hanged in her home, Lewis and Hathaway unearth a far darker murder case than the initial suicide verdict suggests.

videos.title: And the Moonbeams Kiss the Sea
videos.overview: When a man is found dead at the Bodleian Library, Lewis investigates a link between the death and an intruder on a local professor's property.

videos.title: Music to Die For
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway investigate a link between the murder of a professor of German history and the recent winner of a local underground boxing bout.

videos.title: Life Born of Fire
videos.overview: When an old friend of Hathaway's commits suicide, Lewis investigates a link between his death and a religious group whose members are being targeted by a killer.

videos.title: The Great and the Good
videos.overview: A rape case appears to be solved when the chief suspect is murdered. But nothing is what it seems - and soon the upper echelons of Oxford society close ranks.

videos.title: Allegory of Love
videos.overview: Lewis investigates the murder of a beautiful young Eastern European woman whose death comes straight from the pages of a popular fantasy novel.

videos.title: The Quality of Mercy
videos.overview: When Lewis and Hathaway are called in to investigate the murder of a rising Oxford theatre star, they focus their suspicions on his acting colleagues.

videos.title: The Point of Vanishing
videos.overview: When religious fanatic Steven Mullan is murdered, Lewis investigates celebrity atheist Tom Rattenbury and his family, who had been attacked by Mullan.

videos.title: Counter Culture Blues
videos.overview: When Lewis and Hathaway investigate a murder in town, forensic evidence leads them to suspect there is a connection with the reforming of an old rock band.

videos.title: The Dead of Winter
videos.overview: After a body is found on an Oxford tour bus, Lewis and Hathaway are led to Crevecoeur Hall, a sprawling Oxford estate where Hathaway spent much of his childhood.

videos.title: Dark Matter
videos.overview: When the master of a college is found dead at the foot of the observatory stairs, suspicion falls on all of the staff - from senior tutors right down to the scouts.

videos.title: Your Sudden Death Question
videos.overview: On a bank holiday weekend Lewis and Hathaway are called in when a top quiz competitor is found floating dead in the fountain of an Oxford college.

videos.title: Falling Darkness
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway investigate the murder of a university friend of pathologist Laura Hobson. As more deaths occur, they realise that Laura's past may hold the key.

videos.title: Old, Unhappy, Far Off Things
videos.overview: Oxford's last all-female college is holding a reunion party to say goodbye to one of its most popular professors. After a guest is found murdered, Lewis believes the killing is connected to an attack that happened at the same building 10 years ago. He turns to his former DS, Alison McLennan, to help him with the case, but it ends up taking a new twist after two more bodies turn up.

videos.title: Wild Justice
videos.overview: Lewis investigates when a visiting female bishop is poisoned. Then two more deaths occur, both mirroring macabre murders from Jacobean revenge tragedy.

videos.title: The Mind Has Mountains
videos.overview: The ethics of a questionable drug on the Oxford campus of anti-depressants calls into account the questionable judgment of a psychiatry professor.

videos.title: The Gift of Promise
videos.overview: When a local businesswoman is bludgeoned to death, it appears to be a blackmail plot gone wrong. As the body count rises, Lewis and Hathaway realize there is a decades-old secret at the heart of the case, which they must uncover to bring the present-day murders to a halt.

videos.title: The Soul of Genius
videos.overview: When a botanist accidentally digs up the body of the recently buried Murray Hawes, Lewis and Hathaway are set upon a seemingly impossible quest.

videos.title: Generation of Vipers
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway are drawn into a world of virtual bullying, but very real murder, when a professor is found dead after her dating video is leaked online.

videos.title: Fearful Symmetry
videos.overview: When a babysitter is found dead, Lewis and Hathaway are drawn into diverse new worlds including squats, swinging suburbia, primate labs and fetish photography.

videos.title: The Indelible Stain
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway investigate when a controversial American academic is murdered after speaking at Oxford's Department of Criminology.

videos.title: Down Among the Fearful
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway are called in to investigate the death of Reuben Beatty who works at the University of Oxford’s Department of Psychology. He has been discovered dead injected by etorphine, a paralysing agent in the offices of psychic ‘Randolph James’.

videos.title: The Ramblin' Boy
videos.overview: An embalmed body is discovered dumped by an isolated farm track. Funeral director Brian Miller identifies the body and GP Matt Whitby confirms the gentleman died of cancer.

videos.title: Intelligent Design
videos.overview: As Lewis and Hobson embark on a relationship, a former don is murdered on the night of his release from prison - crushed to death by a Jaguar Mark two.

videos.title: Entry Wounds
videos.overview:
Hathaway has been promoted to Inspector after an extended break from the force, and Lewis is enjoying retired life until he's asked to team up with his old colleague again.

Hathaway's murder theory has fallen apart. It might take Lewis's insight to close the case - but will his former protege listen?

videos.title: The Lions of Nemea
videos.overview:
When a classics scholar is stabbed to death and dumped in the Oxford Canal, Lewis, Hathaway and Maddox find themselves sorely tested by a bizarre case.

After a difficult start, Lewis and Hathaway's partnership seems to have gained some semblance of normality. DS Maddox has become a part of the team. Her abilities will be put to the test when an investigation begins on the brutal murder of an American classics student Rose Anderson Her body is hauled from the canal with a stand wound to the neck and abdomen. Suspicious soon fall on astrophysics professor, Felix Garwood who had recently broken off an affair with Rose. However, Felix was married to Rose's supervisor, Philippa Garwood. Could the jealous wife have committed such a murder?

videos.title: Beyond Good and Evil
videos.overview:
Lewis' reputation is jeopardized when the very first case that he solved as a DI is reopened for appeal and new murders are committed with the original weapon.

Hathaway and Maddox continue to investigate the murder of Travis as the trail leads back to Lewis’s original case. The two detectives attempt to prevent another murder and Lewis sees himself isolated and alone with his reputation in jeopardy.

videos.title: One for Sorrow (1)
videos.overview: Lewis and Hathaway are called in to investigate the apparent death by drug overdose of over achieving student and amateur taxidermist Talika Desai.

videos.title: One for Sorrow (2)
videos.overview: Lewis' team must delve into the worlds of social media, drugs, taxidermy, alternative art and the homeless East European community.

videos.title: Magnum Opus (1)
videos.overview: When College Dean Phil Beskin is found bludgeoned to death with a rock in local woodland, Lewis and Hathaway are called in to investigate.

videos.title: Magnum Opus (2)
videos.overview: Before the fourth murder takes place, the team must uncover the guilty secret that their victims share in order to learn the identity of both the killer and the potential victim.

videos.title: What Lies Tangled (1)
videos.overview: When an idyllic Oxford summer's day is torn asunder by a gruesome parcel bomb, Lewis and Hathaway are called in to investigate.

videos.title: What Lies Tangled (2)
videos.overview: With his six-month trip to New Zealand with Hobson on the horizon, Lewis is in a race against time to save his career and relationship.
